stem.text: Which plan diagram represents the tissues in a major vein?

A.alt: Plan diagram of a large outline containing a single smaller ring near its centre.

B.alt: Plan diagram of a large outline containing a middle ring and a smaller ring near its centre.

C.alt: Plan diagram of a large outline containing a single smaller ring near its centre.

D.alt: Plan diagram of a large double-lined outline containing a double-lined inner outline.
